title: About Form 8868, Application for Extension of Time To File an Exempt Organization Return or Excise Taxes Related to Employee Benefit Plans | Internal Revenue Service
text: Skip to main content About Form 8868, Application for Extension of Time To File an Exempt Organization Return or Excise Taxes Related to Employee Benefit Plans More In Forms and Instructions Current year Prior year Accessible eBooks Browser-friendly forms and publications Mobile-friendly forms Post release changes to forms Order forms and publications Help with forms and instructions Comment on tax forms and publications Form 8868 is used by an exempt organization or governmental entity (filing Form 990-T to make an elective payment election), or by the trustee of a trust required to file Form 1041-A or Form 5227 to request an automatic 6-month extension of time to file its return. Also, Form 8868 is used by a Form 5330 filer to request an extension of up to 6 months to file a return for excise taxes related to employee benefit plans.
